title: 第 1 章 重生
slug: 成婚不圆房重生娇娇不嫁他急了
content_zh:
耳边回响起裴砚的冷漠话语，纤细的脖颈被金簪刺破，梅晚萤疼得直掉眼泪。
暗红的血液喷涌而出，星星点点溅落在素色衣襟，开出最刺目的红梅。
裴砚有了红颜知己，他们举止亲密，裴砚看那女子的眼神有欣赏，也有温柔。
有人怒骂：“把她挂城楼上，她是裴砚的妻，肚子里还有裴砚的种，就不信裴砚还能嘴硬！”
content_en:
Pei Yan's indifferent words echoed in her ears, and her slender neck was pierced by a gold hairpin. Mei Wanying shed tears in pain.
Dark red blood spurted out, splashing on the plain clothes, and the most dazzling red plum blossoms bloomed.
Pei Yan had a confidante, and they behaved intimately. Pei Yan looked at the woman with admiration and tenderness.
Someone yelled angrily: "Hang her up on the city tower. She is Pei Yan's wife, and she still has Pei Yan's seed in her belly. I don't believe that Pei Yan can still be arrogant!"
